sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 65

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 65:1
items.html: (To the question) No inner vessel comes into a Partzuf of VAK except by inclusion from its KHB Partzuf, namely after it also attains the KHB Partzuf, then the VAK Partzuf is also included in it, and then it has an inner vessel in its VAK. But before it attains the KHB Partzuf, there is no inner vessel in the VAK. (Item 70).
